answer_1.quote: We evaluated the ODE Transformer on three sequence generation tasks: machine translation, abstractive summarization and grammar error correction... For machine translation tasks, ODE Transformer achieves 30.77 and 44.11 BLEU scores on the WMT'14 En-De and En-Fr test sets... We also tested the models' ability to process long sequences on the CNN-DailyMail summarization task... and on grammar error correction datasets.
answer_1.outputs: Generated translations, abstractive summaries, corrected sentences

answer_2.quote: We report results in terms of BLEU. Both tokenized BLEU and SacreBLEU scores were reported on the En-De and En-Fr tasks. We also measured Rouge-1, Rouge-2, Rouge-L for CNN/DailyMail and precision, recall, F0.5 for CONLL. The truncation error analysis is conducted via perplexity (PPL) on the Penn Treebank.
